passages.text: Hoy el pescado del día es dorada a la plancha, viene con patatas y ensalada. El cordero se nos ha acabado, lo siento. Y de postre, la tarta de queso es casera, la recomiendo mucho.
passages.en: Today's fish is grilled sea bream, served with potatoes and salad. We've run out of lamb, sorry. And for dessert, the cheesecake is homemade, I highly recommend it.
passages.question: Which statement is true?
passages.answer: There is no lamb left today.
wrong: The lamb is the dish of the day.
The fish comes with rice and beans.

passages.text: Hoje o peixe do dia é dourada grelhada, vem com batatas e salada. O borrego já acabou, peço desculpa. E de sobremesa, o bolo de bolacha é feito cá em casa, recomendo muito.
passages.en: Today's fish is grilled sea bream, served with potatoes and salad. The lamb has run out, sorry. And for dessert, the biscuit cake is homemade, I highly recommend it.
passages.question: Which statement is true?
passages.answer: There is no lamb left today.
wrong: The lamb is the dish of the day.
The fish comes with rice and beans.
The biscuit cake is sold out.

passages.text: Hoy de primero tenemos sopa de pescado o ensalada. De segundo, bacalao al horno o carne guisada. El postre y la bebida están incluidos en el menú; el café, no.
passages.en: Today to start we have fish soup or salad. For the main course, baked cod or stewed meat. Dessert and a drink are included in the set menu; coffee isn't.
passages.question: What's NOT included in the set menu?

passages.text: Hoje, para entrada, temos sopa de peixe ou salada. Como prato principal, bacalhau no forno ou carne estufada. A sobremesa e a bebida estão incluídas no menu; o café, não.
passages.en: Today to start we have fish soup or salad. For the main course, baked cod or stewed meat. Dessert and a drink are included in the set menu; coffee isn't.
passages.question: What's NOT included in the set menu?

passages.text: Lo siento muchísimo, ahora mismo se lo cambio. Le traigo otro plato recién hecho, tarda unos diez minutos. Y el postre, por las molestias, corre de nuestra cuenta.
passages.en: I'm so sorry, I'll change it right away. I'll bring you a freshly made dish; it takes about ten minutes. And dessert is on us for the trouble.
passages.question: What does the waiter offer?
passages.answer: A new dish in about ten minutes and a free dessert.
wrong: To take the dish off the bill only.

passages.text: Peço imensa desculpa, troco já. Trago-lhe outro prato acabado de fazer, demora uns dez minutos. E a sobremesa, pelo incómodo, fica por nossa conta.
passages.en: I'm so sorry, I'll change it right away. I'll bring you a freshly made dish; it takes about ten minutes. And dessert is on us for the trouble.
passages.question: What does the waiter offer?
passages.answer: A new dish in about ten minutes and a free dessert.

passages.text: Para el pescado les recomiendo un blanco gallego, fresco y afrutado. Si prefieren tinto, uno ligero también funciona. Lo tenemos por copa o por botella.
passages.en: For the fish I recommend a fresh, fruity white. If you prefer red, a light one works too. We have it by the glass or by the bottle.
passages.question: What does the waiter recommend with fish?
passages.answer: A fresh, fruity white, or a light red.
wrong: Sparkling wine by the bottle only.

passages.text: Para o peixe recomendo um vinho verde, fresco e frutado. Se preferirem tinto, um leve também resulta. Temos a copo ou à garrafa.
passages.en: For the fish I recommend a fresh, fruity white. If you prefer red, a light one works too. We have it by the glass or by the bottle.
